spec: ES module exporting `parseCsvLine(line)`: splits ONE line of RFC 4180 CSV into an array of field strings. Separator is a comma. A field may be wrapped in double quotes; inside quotes, commas are literal and a doubled quote ("") stands for one quote character. Quotes are only special at the very start of a field. No trimming of whitespace.
properties: unquoted fields are split on every comma, keeping whitespace ("a, b" gives ["a", " b"])
a quoted field keeps commas literally and has its surrounding quotes removed
inside a quoted field, "" becomes a single " character
empty fields are kept, including a trailing empty field ("a,," gives ["a", "", ""]) and the empty line gives [""]
an unterminated quoted field throws a SyntaxError
